title: 7.3 Proving That a Quadrilateral Is a Parallelogram

icans: I can name the theorem that proves a quadrilateral is a parallelogram.
I can find values of variables that make a quadrilateral a parallelogram.
I can use slope, distance, or midpoints to show a quadrilateral in the coordinate plane is a parallelogram.

vocab: the statement made by switching the _____________ and the conclusion
both pairs of opposite sides ____________ → parallelogram
both pairs of opposite angles ____________ → parallelogram
Opposite Sides Parallel and Congruent Theorem
one __________ of opposite sides both congruent and parallel → parallelogram
